description: Block until a sim's deploy reaches a terminal status (`active` or `failed`) or until `timeout_s` seconds elapse (default 25, max 30). Returns `{sim_id, status, urls: {live, dashboard}}` — `urls.live` is set once the deploy is ACTIVE. On timeout the response carries the current non-terminal status (typically `deploying`); the agent can call `wait_for_deploy` again with the same `sim_id`.
name: wait_for_deploy
